changelog:
- Initial release of fsd-secure: a Camera-Only Full Self-Driving agent prioritizing safety.
- Introduced Dual-Pass Verification using two independent algorithms to clear paths.
- Added Temporal Consistency requirement: 3 consecutive safe frames needed before moving.
- Implemented Emergency Stop on any uncertainty as a fail-safe.
- Included `drive` command to start simulation.
summary: Full Self-Driving agent with highest safety standards (Camera-Only, Redundant Checks).
